releaseNotes:
Release v0.4.8

- "Buy me a coffee" card at the top of Settings if you'd like to support development
- New "Share usage stats" toggle in Settings to help improve Scoot with anonymous usage data
- Update check fixed: no more update banner right after installing the latest version; auto-check now runs when the app opens (once a day)
- Dashboard: removed the duplicate dot next to the velocity readout
- Navigation: compass now turns the right way; bottom card shrinks to an icon while you drag the map; warm map style by default
- Navigation: place search shows results as you type
- Ride Telemetry: screen title no longer cut off when connected
- Trip history: sort chips scroll sideways instead of wrapping on narrow screens
- Trip detail: dropped the min-speed stat; Eco/Power split only appears with real cluster data
- Trip detail: share now offers a Google Maps route link, plus the GPX file option
